summary: Added a full hand-written OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code + PKCE + Dynamic Client Registration login command (internal/cli/auth_login.go) and registered it in the generated auth command group.
reason: cli-printing-press has no generator template for OAuth 2.1 PKCE + DCR (only device_code/client_credentials/simple bearer are template-backed). Swiggy Builders Club requires this exact flow (phone+OTP consent, no static API key). Implemented per references/oauth2-pkce-cli-checklist.md: fresh state/verifier per attempt, S256 challenge, state validated before code exchange, loopback-only callback, separate timeouts for browser-wait vs token-exchange, token-exchange client that refuses cross-origin redirects.
validated_outcome: Full login flow completed end-to-end against production mcp.swiggy.com in this session (real phone+OTP, real DCR registration, real token issued and stored). gosec G112 (Slowloris) fixed with ReadHeaderTimeout on the loopback callback server; G204 suppressed with a narrow, reviewed #nosec justification for the fixed-argv per-OS browser-open exec.
